title: Skip counting on the count row (`count-row`): count by 1-12 and any step, the number-line row and the grid row

template.also: The provider `js/modules/sheet/providers/countby.js` (strings, workedSteps, wrongAnswer, footprint) and the count-row lesson data in `js/modules/lessons/prereqs.js`. `screen-cell.js` draws the same row on the practice card, online worksheet and quiz; on a phone the row swipes on one line (wireSwipeRows) and opens at the first answer box. The 'train' look of the same template (number_patterns_rule, seq_*) is the algebra lane's and is not on this card.

summary: Template card for the skip-count row. One row per count: the step in a boxed tab at the left, hop arcs over the numbers, given numbers plain, every missing number an empty writing box in its own place (SL-11). count_by_tables deals the tables 1-12 (or the teacher's own rows: any step, start and direction) as two lines of 6; skip_count_line draws the same row on a ruled number line with a tick under every number; skip_count_grid deals the 2s / 5s / 10s count on a hundred-square strip. Key = the same row with every box written in. Paper, key and the three screen hosts are one drawing.
teaches: Count by a step (1.NBT.A.1 count to 120; 2.NBT.A.2 count by 5s, 10s and 100s within 1,000; 3.OA.C.7 know the multiples as the table's count; 4.OA.B.4 multiples). WRM Y2.B1.S15 (2s, 5s, 10s), Y2.B1.S16 (3s), Y4.B4 S1-S10 (multiples of 3, 6, 9, 7, 11, 12). A count row is a structure the pupil fills from left to right; the first two printed numbers show the step.
research: From repo sources: design/status/skip-count.md (critic r1-r5 rounds, SC1-SC6, small-fixes G1-G6), WORKSHEET_DESIGN_STANDARD TY-10 / TY-10b (the count row, the one-line swipe ruling), PROBLEM_TYPES count rows, design/catalogue/mult-div-integers.md. Reference grammar (MathWorksheets4Kids skip-counting strips and 'fill in the missing multiples', IXL 'skip-count by 3s' number-line hops, K5 Learning count-by rows): a row of 10-12 numbers with blanks; ours keeps 12 numbers in two lines of 6, one box per missing number, never a line under the row.
problemTypes: count row (arcs look): the step tab, the first two numbers printed, the rest blank or half blank; write the missing multiples - the core item
count row with a start that is not the step (by 5 from 3: 3, 8, 13 ...) or counting back towards 0 (teacher's own rows)
count row with the times label under each number (option `times`: '1 x 4' ...), a hint that fades (drawn at levels 1 and 3, grey at 2, dropped on tests)
number-line row (skip_count_line): the same hops above a ruled line, a tick per number, each missing number a box under its tick
grid row (skip_count_grid): the 2s / 5s / 10s count on a hundred-square strip, the missing squares boxed
progression: count by 2, 5, 10 from 0 (Y2 / grade 1) -> count by 3 -> the tables 4, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11, 12 (Y4 / grade 3), one table a step (P-1)
first two numbers printed (shows the step) -> first one only -> half blank (fill)
times labels on (a hint) -> off; tests never draw them (P-7)
count on -> count back towards 0 -> a start that is not the step

drawing.sizes: box pitch 13.5 / 14 / 15.5 mm (S / M / L), boxes at least the answer-area minimum, digits at the working size 16 / 22 / 28 pt (wide numbers keep the box as wide as the widest number, never below 9 pt); hop arcs 0.75 pt, the step tab 1.5 pt outline; a row is two lines of 6 numbers across the 186 mm live width, a turn arrow leaving and entering each line.
notes: payload: values, blanks (ascending), look 'arcs' (this card), tab (the step), shape (box / circle / hex / mixed), times ('each' | 'given') + labels, axis (the number-line look), tabHint.
Every missing number is one empty writing box in its own place (SL-11); the screen twin gives each box data-mq-cell, answers joined ', ' in reading order (q.ans).
Key (AK-1, AK-2): the same row with every box written in; nothing else changes.

Phone (TY-10b, owner ruling 2026-10-17 (3)): the row swipes on ONE line, opens at the first answer box focused; a box stays >= 44 px; nothing cut except by its window (ws-phone-card FOCUS / INVIEW / ROW-LINES / ROW-ARROW / NEXT-INVIEW / ROTATE).
Lesson pages (SC1, SC3): the lesson count rows fit their cell, givens never black on black, the key has the same number of boxes as the pupil page; count-row states (S6 anchors) are lesson-only.

openQuestions.q: Sign the decisions in 7a as proposed (every count-row option offered, the number-line and play controls out of scope, the boss / race / map / display modes out of scope)?

Precritic held critic r6 on three reds that are not count-row defects: (a) sibling-compare finds no approved count-row sibling (77 unproven counts); (b) options-verify --render: shape and 15-jump pages hold fewer rows than the default page; (c) --role lesson ratchet on placevalue:more_less_10 CL40-INK (also red on the integration branch). Rule: (a) this card is the first count-row drawing, so sibling-compare is SKIPPED-owner until it passes; (b) fewer rows is the expected cost of shaped tiles (two even lines) and of 15 numbers (three lines of 5), not a capacity defect, provided H13 holds on those pages; (c) not this lane's skill: the placevalue lane fixes it, the row is pinned meanwhile?
Hide the word-problems, fact-rows and fact-probe page types for the three count-row skills (a count row has no story and is not a fact)?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes: the page-type list every skill must reach (CLAUDE.md) does not include them; daily / mixed review keeps the count row.

openQuestions.q: Answer spaces = Lines (owner 2026-10-03, an exception to SL-3) stays offered on count_by_tables only, default Boxes?
Times labels (the multiplication fact under each number): a hint that fades each -> given -> none, grey on Guided, dropped on Test, Review and the pre-skill check. Keep?

I Can line: count_by_tables titles itself from its rows ("I can count by 3s", "I can count back by 5s from 60"); with the default rows (tables 2 to 12) it reads "I can count by 2s to 12s" (critic r5 SC6 flagged "count by 1 to 12"). Accept?

G1-Y2.B1 build entry count_row_end (an option on count_by_tables, links proposal only): the row ENDS at a given number (count by 2s to 20, 5s to 50, 10s to 100), as WRM Y2.B1.S15. Make it an option `endAt` (a number), a plain option (not a preset skill: it is a range tweak)?
openQuestions.recommended: Yes: plain option, built in this lane after signing.
